characters.description: friendly stickman teacher with round glasses and a red tie
small stickman kid with a yellow cap

scenes.narration: Have you ever wondered why the sky is blue?
scenes.image_prompt: kid looking up at a bright sky, outdoor park

scenes.narration: Sunlight looks white, but it is really made of every color.
scenes.image_prompt: teacher holding a prism splitting light into a rainbow

scenes.narration: Blue light scatters the most when it hits the air, so we see blue everywhere.
scenes.image_prompt: teacher and kid pointing at a blue sky with scattering light rays
